panels.caption: Miso finally made it to space!
panels.image_prompt: A cute orange tabby cat astronaut named Miso floating inside a bright space station, looking excited, wearing a small white spacesuit with a fish patch

panels.caption: Wait... how high up are we?
panels.image_prompt: The same orange tabby cat astronaut Miso floating inside a bright space station, looking down at Earth through a round window, eyes wide with worry

panels.caption: Okay. No looking down. No looking down.
panels.image_prompt: The same orange tabby cat astronaut Miso floating inside a bright space station, clinging tightly to a handrail with both paws, trembling

panels.caption: Still scared. Still flying. Meow.
panels.image_prompt: The same orange tabby cat astronaut Miso floating inside a bright space station, smiling bravely and waving at Earth through the round window
